verdict.rationale: The axis clearly applies to an OS. The only evidence of a Windows setup flow is community reports: one describes running Windows setup and working around the hidden local-account option, and another describes wiping a PC and reinstalling Windows with an offline account. No first-party install documentation is in the pack. Missing for 10: official installation/clean-install documentation, evidence of replacing a non-Windows OS on the same machine, and install-media and hardware-requirement guidance for switchers.
